# Public civil judgment excerpts

- `de-vasconcelos.txt`: the neutral citation and paragraph 1 of [De Vasconcelos v Business Partners, [2019] ZASCA 80](https://www3.saflii.org/za/cases/ZASCA/2019/80.html).
- `wolmarans.txt`: paragraphs 6 and 15 of [68 Wolmarans Street Johannesburg v Tufh, [2024] ZASCA 48](https://www.supremecourtofappeal.org.za/index.php/component/jdownloads/send/94-judgements-2024/4207-68-wolmarans-street-johannesburg-pty-ltd-and-others-v-tufh-limited-1263-2022-2024-zasca-48-15-april-2024?Itemid=0). PDF line wrapping is retained; page numbers and unrelated footnotes between pages are omitted.

These are excerpts, not complete judgments. Tests also create explicitly synthetic layout variants (dot-numbered paragraphs, extra line breaks, footnote marks and reference blocks) from these real words. They do not represent those variants as the court's original layout. No client material or live network is used by the tests.
